description: This Java source file defines the AdminController class, providing REST API endpoints for administrative user management, credential handling, and audit logs in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: REST controller exposing admin operations for user and credential management, as well as audit logs.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all users with their details.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Enables or disables a user based on the provided UUID and active flag.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Returns a list of credentials (authenticators) for a specified user.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a specific authenticator credential by its ID.

methods.name: audit
methods.description: Returns a count of audit entries; placeholder for full audit log.
